PAGE TITLE: SECTION 2 Financial Section

PHOTOS: An aerial/high-angle photo showing the launch of a SpaceX rocket with massive clouds of smoke and exhaust rising from the launch pad, with land and ocean visible in the background.
Caption: PHOTO CREDIT: SpaceX. Text describes it as the third integrated flight test of the Super Heavy booster and Starship upper stage, launched on March 14, SpaceX Starbase orbital launch pad at 8:25 a.m. CDT, as part of NASA's Artemis campaign working with SpaceX to develop the Starship human landing system (HLS).

KEY FACTS:
- SpaceX launched the third integrated flight test of its Super Heavy booster and Starship upper stage on March 14 at 8:25 a.m. CDT from Starbase orbital launch pad.
- The Super Heavy booster features 33 Raptor engines fueled by super-cooled liquid methane and liquid oxygen.
- Starship uses six Raptor engines.
- Hot-staging technique to fire the engines before separation occurred at approximately three minutes into the flight.
